QuestInfo.name: [Mechanical Hearts 3] Sky's the Limit
QuestInfo.0: Try talking to the #bstrange boy#k standing to one side of the storage room.
QuestInfo.2: The boy introduced himself as #bSky#k, and says he was created by #bScion#k to be used as shell for its consciousness. He says if you help him leave the storage room, he'll help you turn on #bScion's Old Mainframe#k.
